instructions.summary: A full-depth barbell squat with the bar on the upper back.
setup: Set bar at upper-chest height in rack.
Step under bar, position across upper traps.
Grip just outside shoulder width.
Unrack, step back, feet shoulder-width, toes flared.
execution: Deep breath and brace core 360 degrees.
Push knees out in direction of toes.
Sit down and back, chest up.
Descend until hip crease is below top of knee.
Drive through whole foot to stand.
Keep knees tracking over toes on ascent.
common_errors: Knee cave on ascent — cue: push knees out.
instructions.breathing_cue: Valsalva: inhale fully at top, brace, hold through rep, exhale at lockout.
safety_notes: Always use safeties set just below parallel.
Have a spotter for near-maximal attempts.

contraindications.note: Reduce load, consider SSB.

instructions.summary: A hip-hinge pulling pattern, lifting a loaded barbell from the floor.
setup: Bar over mid-foot, about 1 inch from shins.
Hip-width stance, toes slightly flared.
Hinge to bar, grip just outside legs.
Take slack out of bar before pulling.
execution: Drive floor away with legs first.
Bar stays in contact with legs throughout.
Hips and shoulders rise at same rate initially.
Lock out hips and knees simultaneously at top.
Return bar under control by hinging at hips first.
common_errors: Bar swinging away from body — keep it close.
Jerking the bar off the floor — build tension first.
Rounding lower back heavily under load.
Not locking out fully at top.
instructions.breathing_cue: Valsalva before the pull. Reset breath between reps.
safety_notes: Never jerk the bar — build tension from the floor.
If back rounds excessively, reduce load.
coaching_cues: Drive hips through at the top.
Squeeze the floor apart with your feet.

regressions.description: Teaches hinge pattern without floor pull

contraindications.note: Seek professional advice before loading.

instructions.summary: A horizontal press with barbell from a supine position on a bench.
setup: Eyes under the bar.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Plant feet flat on floor.
Arch back slightly, retract and depress scapula.
Unrack by extending arms fully.
execution: Lower bar with control to lower chest / sternum.
Keep elbows at 45-75 degrees from torso.
Touch chest lightly — no bounce.
Press in a slight arc back to start position.
Lock out fully at top.
common_errors: Elbows flaring 90 degrees — increases shoulder injury risk.
instructions.breathing_cue: Inhale on descent, brace, press on exhale or hold through short reps.
safety_notes: Use a spotter or set safeties in power rack.
Never unrack or rerack alone without safeties on heavy sets.
coaching_cues: Drive your back into the bench.
Bar to lower chest, not neck.

contraindications.note: Consider DB bench or floor press as alternative.

instructions.summary: A vertical pressing movement from shoulder to overhead lockout.
setup: Bar resting on front delts in rack position.
Grip just outside shoulder-width.
Elbows slightly in front of bar.
Feet hip-width or slightly narrower.
execution: Squeeze glutes and brace core.
Press bar straight up, moving head back slightly to clear chin.
Move head back through as bar passes.
Lock out fully overhead with bar over mid-foot.
common_errors: Pressing in front of body rather than directly overhead.
Lower back arching excessively — engage glutes.
instructions.breathing_cue: Brace before pressing, exhale at lockout.
safety_notes: If you fail, push bar forward and step back.
Reduce load if lower back pain occurs — check hip flexor tightness.
coaching_cues: Move your head back and through.

progressions.description: Allows heavier loading with leg drive

contraindications.note: Check shoulder mobility before loading overhead.

instructions.summary: A bent-over barbell pull for back thickness, rowed from the floor or from a hinged hold.
setup: Bar over mid-foot, hip-width stance.
Hinge to roughly parallel with the floor, back flat.
Grip just outside shoulder width, overhand.
Take the slack out of the bar before rowing.
execution: Brace the core and keep the torso angle fixed.
Row the bar to the lower chest / upper abdomen.
Lead with the elbows and squeeze the mid-back at the top.
Lower under control to full arm extension.
common_errors: Torso rising through the rep to cheat the weight.
Jerking the bar with the lower back.
Rowing too high into the neck.
Shortening the range at the bottom.
instructions.breathing_cue: Brace at the hinge, exhale on the row.
safety_notes: Keep a neutral spine - reduce load if the back rounds.
Rest the bar on the floor between reps if position degrades.

substitutes.reason: Lower back cannot tolerate the hinge

progressions.description: Allows heavier loading with chest support

regressions.description: Removes the need to hold the hinge position

contraindications.note: Use a chest-supported row instead to remove spinal load.

instructions.summary: Plate-loaded machine row targeting lats and mid-back.
setup: Set seat so handles align with lower chest.
Chest against pad, neutral grip.
execution: Retract shoulder blades first.
Drive elbows back and squeeze peak contraction.
Return under control.

instructions.summary: Machine-guided horizontal press for chest hypertrophy.
setup: Seat height so handles align with mid-chest.
Feet flat, back against pad.
execution: Press to full extension without locking out aggressively.
Controlled 2-second eccentric return.
Do not let weight stack touch between reps.

instructions.summary: Ab wheel rollout or crunch for core stability and strength.
setup: Kneel on pad, wheel under shoulders.
Maintain hollow body position.
execution: Roll forward keeping core braced.
Extend until hips are near floor level.
Pull back using abs, not hip flexors.
safety_notes: Start from knees if full rollout too difficult.

contraindications.note: Use crunch variation instead.

instructions.summary: Machine preacher curl isolating the biceps with constant tension.
setup: Seat so upper arms fully supported on pad.
Grip handles at shoulder width.
execution: Curl to full contraction, hold briefly.
Lower under control maintaining constant tension.
common_errors: Letting arms fully extend at bottom (loses tension)

instructions.summary: Wide-grip cable pulldown for lat width and upper back development.
setup: Grip wider than shoulder width, overhand.
Thighs secured under pads.
Slight lean back.
execution: Initiate with shoulder blades depressing.
Drive elbows down and back toward hips.
Bar to upper chest, hold briefly.
Return under full control.
common_errors: Pulling with arms first instead of lats

instructions.summary: Seated machine curl isolating the hamstrings.
setup: Adjust so knee joint aligns with machine pivot.
Pad rests on lower shin.
execution: Curl heels toward glutes.
Hold at peak contraction.
Slow 3-second eccentric return.

instructions.summary: Machine fly for chest isolation with deep stretch and peak contraction.
setup: Seat so handles align with mid-chest.
Slight bend in elbows throughout.
execution: Open arms wide for deep stretch.
Squeeze pecs to bring arms together.
Hold 1s at peak, return under control.

contraindications.note: Limit range of motion if pain occurs.

instructions.summary: Machine dip for tricep development and lockout strength.
setup: Adjust seat for 90-degree elbow at start.
Grip handles, elbows close to body.
execution: Press to full lockout — lock elbows out hard.
Return under control.
Keep torso upright.
coaching_cues: Lock elbows out hard at top.

contraindications.note: Reduce depth if shoulder pain occurs.

instructions.summary: Cable rope pull to face for rear delt and rotator cuff health.
setup: Set cable to upper chest/face height.
Rope attachment, grip each end with thumbs up.
execution: Pull rope to face level, elbows flaring out.
External rotate at end — hands out and back.
Hold 1s at face, return under control.
coaching_cues: Think: pull rope apart at end.

instructions.summary: Plate-loaded leg press for quad and glute hypertrophy.
setup: Feet shoulder-width at mid-height on platform.
Back and head flat against pad.
execution: Lower sled under control until 90-degree knee angle.
Press through full foot.
Do not lock knees at top.
common_errors: Feet too high (becomes a glute exercise)
safety_notes: Always use safety stops.
Do not lock knees at top.
coaching_cues: Do not lock knees at top.

contraindications.note: Limit depth and avoid knee lockout.

instructions.summary: Machine isolation for quadriceps, emphasising VMO at lockout.
setup: Adjust so knee aligns with machine pivot.
Pad across lower shin.
execution: Extend to full lockout squeezing VMO.
Hold 1s at top.
Return under control.

contraindications.note: Consult physio before use.

instructions.summary: Back extension for lower back and glute strength.
setup: Pad at hip crease, feet secured.
Arms crossed or holding weight plate.
execution: Hinge forward under control.
Extend back to neutral or slight hyperextension.
Squeeze glutes hard at top.
safety_notes: Keep movement controlled — no ballistic swinging.
coaching_cues: Hinge at hips, not lower back.

contraindications.note: Use light load only, avoid full hyperextension.

instructions.summary: Unilateral dumbbell row braced on a bench, for back thickness and lat development.
setup: Knee and same-side hand on bench for support.
Opposite foot flat on floor.
Dumbbell hanging directly below shoulder.
Neutral spine — no rotation.
execution: Row dumbbell toward hip, elbow close to body.
Lead with elbow, not hand.
Squeeze lat and rhomboid at top.
Lower under full control to full arm extension.
common_errors: Pulling with bicep instead of back
Not reaching full extension at bottom
instructions.breathing_cue: Exhale on row, inhale on descent.

instructions.summary: Inclined dumbbell press targeting upper pectoralis and anterior deltoid.
setup: Set bench to 30–45 degrees.
Dumbbells at chest level, neutral or pronated grip.
Retract and depress scapulae into pad.
execution: Press to full lockout above upper chest.
Lower under control to slight stretch at chest.
Keep elbows 45–60 degrees from torso.
common_errors: Bench angle too steep — becomes a shoulder press

contraindications.note: Reduce range of motion if pain occurs.

instructions.summary: Hanging from a bar, raising legs to parallel or above for core strength.
setup: Dead hang from pull-up bar, shoulder-width grip.
Posterior pelvic tilt before raising.
execution: Raise straight legs to parallel or above by flexing abs.
Avoid swinging — initiate with core.
Lower under control without losing tension.
common_errors: Only using hip flexors — no posterior tilt

contraindications.note: Use knee raise variation to reduce lever arm.

instructions.summary: Unilateral cable lateral raise for medial delt isolation with constant tension.
setup: Set cable to lowest pulley, single handle.
Stand side-on to machine, cable crossing in front of body.
Slight bend in elbow throughout.
execution: Raise arm out to just above shoulder height.
Lead with elbow, not hand.
Hold 1s at top, return under control.
coaching_cues: Pour the water jug at top.

contraindications.note: Reduce range of motion if impingement occurs.

instructions.summary: Neutral-grip dumbbell curl targeting brachialis and brachioradialis for arm thickness.
setup: Stand or sit, dumbbells at sides with neutral grip (thumbs forward).
Elbows pinned at sides.
execution: Curl to full contraction keeping neutral grip.
Squeeze at top.
Lower under control.

instructions.summary: Cable pushdown for tricep isolation and pump.
setup: Set cable to high pulley, rope or bar attachment.
Grip overhand, elbows pinned at sides at 90 degrees.
Slight forward lean.
execution: Extend elbows to full lockout.
Flare rope ends apart at bottom for full contraction.
Return under control to start — don't let elbows wing.

contraindications.note: Avoid full lockout if pain at elbow.

instructions.summary: Bodyweight vertical pull for lat and upper back strength.
setup: Hang with overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Depress scapulae before pulling.
execution: Drive elbows down and back toward hips.
Pull chest to bar.
Lower under full control to dead hang.
common_errors: Not achieving full dead hang at bottom

regressions.description: Assisted vertical pull to build strength

contraindications.note: Avoid full dead hang if shoulder pain present.

instructions.summary: Seated barbell good morning for erector spinae and hamstring strength with reduced spinal load vs standing.
setup: Sit on bench or box, bar across upper traps.
Feet flat, knees at 90 degrees.
Tall spine before initiating.
execution: Hinge forward at hips, lowering chest toward thighs.
Maintain neutral spine — no rounding.
Extend back to upright by driving hips forward.
common_errors: Initiating with spine flexion not hip hinge
instructions.breathing_cue: Brace before hinge, exhale on extension.
safety_notes: Use conservative load — spinal erectors fatigue fast.
Stop if lower back rounds under load.
coaching_cues: Squeeze glutes on the way up.

contraindications.note: High spinal load — seek professional advice.

instructions.summary: Isometric core hold in a push-up position for anterior core endurance.
setup: Forearms or hands on floor, elbows under shoulders.
Body forms a straight line from head to heels.
execution: Brace core 360 degrees — ribs down, glutes squeezed.
Hold position without sagging hips or raising glutes.
Breathe steadily throughout hold.

instructions.summary: Calf raise for gastrocnemius and soleus hypertrophy.
setup: Ball of foot on edge of platform.
Full range: deep stretch at bottom.
execution: Rise onto toes, hold 1s at peak.
Lower slowly for deep stretch at bottom.
Do not bounce at bottom.

instructions.summary: Standing barbell curl for bilateral bicep development.
setup: Supinated grip shoulder-width or slightly narrower.
Elbows pinned at sides.
Slight forward lean acceptable.
execution: Curl to full contraction.
Squeeze biceps hard at top.
Lower under control — full extension at bottom.
common_errors: Not achieving full extension at bottom

substitutes.reason: For strict form with no body swing

instructions.summary: Cable overhead tricep extension emphasising the long head of the tricep through a stretched position.
setup: Set cable to low pulley, rope attachment.
Face away from stack, rope held behind head.
Elbows pointing forward, upper arms vertical.
execution: Extend elbows overhead to full lockout.
Flare rope ends apart at lockout.
Return under control — deep stretch behind head.

contraindications.note: Avoid deep stretch position if pain occurs.

instructions.summary: Plate-loaded row for back thickness, allowing heavier loading than dumbbells.
setup: Chest against pad (machine) or hinge to 45 degrees (landmine).
V-grip or neutral grip handles.
Neutral spine throughout.
execution: Retract shoulder blades before pulling.
Drive elbows back until handles reach chest.
Squeeze mid-back at peak.
Return under full control.
common_errors: Not fully retracting scapulae at top
safety_notes: Keep neutral spine — do not round under heavy load.

contraindications.note: Use chest-supported variation to remove spinal load.

instructions.summary: Dumbbell fly on a flat bench for chest stretch and isolation.
setup: Lie flat, dumbbells held above chest with slight elbow bend.
Retract scapulae into bench.
execution: Lower dumbbells in arc to sides until stretch in chest.
Keep slight elbow bend throughout — never lock out.
Squeeze chest to bring dumbbells back together.
common_errors: Lowering too far — rotator cuff risk
instructions.breathing_cue: Inhale on descent, exhale on squeeze.
safety_notes: Do not lower past comfortable shoulder range — stop at slight stretch.

contraindications.note: Reduce range of motion if pain occurs.

instructions.summary: Rotational core exercise targeting the obliques.
setup: Sit on floor, knees bent, torso leaned back 45 degrees.
Hold weight plate or medicine ball at chest.
Feet can be elevated for added difficulty.
execution: Rotate torso fully to one side, touch weight to floor.
Return through centre to opposite side.
Keep chest up — do not round.

contraindications.note: Avoid weighted variation; use unweighted with smaller ROM.

instructions.summary: Lying EZ-bar extension for tricep long-head mass.
setup: Lie flat on bench, EZ bar held above chest with arms extended.
Grip inside knurling, elbows shoulder-width.
execution: Hinge at elbows lowering bar toward forehead or just behind.
Keep upper arms vertical and stationary.
Extend to full lockout.
common_errors: Upper arms drifting back during descent (becomes a pullover)
Locking elbows out too aggressively with heavy weight
instructions.breathing_cue: Inhale on descent, exhale on extension.
safety_notes: Use a spotter on heavy sets — drop zone is the face.
Lower to forehead first, not directly overhead, until comfortable.

contraindications.note: Reduce range of motion at bottom if pain occurs.

instructions.summary: Rear-foot elevated unilateral squat for quad and glute hypertrophy with minimal spinal load.
setup: Rear foot elevated on bench at knee height behind.
Front foot far enough forward that knee stays over foot at bottom.
Hold dumbbells at sides or barbell on back.
execution: Descend until rear knee nearly touches floor.
Drive through front heel to stand.
Keep front shin roughly vertical.
common_errors: Front foot too close (knee caves over toes)
instructions.breathing_cue: Inhale on descent, exhale on drive up.
safety_notes: Start light — balance demands are high.

regressions.description: Bilateral until unilateral balance is established

contraindications.note: Monitor knee tracking — consult physio if pain occurs.

instructions.summary: Glute ham raise machine exercise for hamstring and glute strength through full knee flexion range.
setup: Feet secured in GHR machine, knees on pad.
Start in horizontal or slightly inclined position.
execution: Lower body under control by extending knees.
Use hamstrings and glutes to return to start.
Maintain neutral spine throughout.
safety_notes: Very difficult — use an assisted version (bands or push-up assist) if needed.

regressions.description: Machine isolation to build hamstring strength first

contraindications.note: High eccentric load — progress very conservatively.

instructions.summary: Kneeling cable crunch for weighted ab flexion with constant tension.
setup: Kneel facing stack, rope pulled to sides of face.
Hips stay fixed — do not sit back during movement.
execution: Flex spine, driving elbows toward knees.
Crunch fully, hold 1s at peak contraction.
Return under control without losing rope tension.
common_errors: Hipping back — using hip flexors instead of abs

contraindications.note: Reduce load and range of motion.

instructions.summary: Dumbbell shrug for upper trap hypertrophy.
setup: Stand with dumbbells at sides, neutral grip.
Arms straight, no elbow bend.
execution: Shrug straight up — ears to shoulders.
Hold 1s at peak.
Lower under full control.

instructions.summary: Seated incline curl for bicep long-head stretch and peak, with the arm extended behind the body.
setup: Sit on incline bench set to 45–60 degrees.
Arms hang straight down — shoulder is behind hip for deep stretch.
execution: Supinate and curl to full contraction.
Do not swing or raise shoulders to assist.
Lower slowly to full extension — feel the long-head stretch.
common_errors: Bench angle too steep — reduces stretch

instructions.summary: Cable kickback for tricep isolation with constant tension at full extension.
setup: Set cable to low pulley, single handle.
Hinge forward, upper arm parallel to floor and pinned at side.
Start with elbow at 90 degrees.
execution: Extend elbow until arm is fully straight.
Hold 1s at full extension — squeeze tricep.
Return under control to 90 degrees.
coaching_cues: Upper arm stays parallel to floor.

substitutes.reason: No cable setup for kickback position

instructions.summary: Standing dumbbell curl with full supination at the top for peak bicep contraction.
setup: Stand or sit, dumbbells at sides with neutral or supinated starting grip.
Elbows pinned at sides.
execution: Curl while supinating wrist outward as weight rises.
Squeeze bicep hard at top.
Lower under control with full extension at bottom.
coaching_cues: Supinate wrist on the way up.

instructions.summary: Seated cable row targeting back thickness with constant cable tension.
setup: Sit on platform, feet on footrests, slight knee bend.
Grab V-bar or handle, sit tall with neutral spine.
Pull cable taut before starting.
execution: Retract shoulder blades first.
Drive elbows back and squeeze shoulder blades together at peak.
Return under control — let shoulder blades protract slightly for full stretch.
Maintain upright torso — no layback.
common_errors: Leaning back excessively to assist pull

contraindications.note: Keep torso upright — reduce load if pain occurs.

instructions.summary: High-tension isometric plank where glutes and abs are simultaneously contracted at maximum effort to flatten the lower back — used as APT correction.
setup: Forearms on floor, elbows under shoulders.
Body in a straight line, feet together.
execution: Squeeze glutes as hard as possible.
Simultaneously contract abs to posteriorly tilt the pelvis.
Drive elbows toward toes without moving them.
Maintain 100% full-body tension throughout the hold.
instructions.breathing_cue: Short, sharp breaths — do not hold breath.

substitutes.reason: Standard plank if RKC tension not achievable

regressions.description: Standard plank to build baseline hold endurance

instructions.summary: Supine contralateral limb movement with lower back pressed flat into the floor — a core anti-extension drill used for APT correction.
setup: Lie on back, arms vertical above chest, hips and knees at 90 degrees.
Press lower back firmly into the floor — it must not leave the floor at any point.
execution: Slowly lower opposite arm and leg toward the floor simultaneously.
Lower only as far as the lower back stays flat.
Return to start and repeat on the other side.
common_errors: Lower back lifting off the floor — reduce range of motion if this occurs
Moving too fast and losing lumbar contact
instructions.breathing_cue: Exhale fully and brace before each rep.
safety_notes: Do not lower limbs so far that the lumbar lifts — floor contact is the point of the exercise.
coaching_cues: Back flat to the floor — non-negotiable.

contraindications.note: Reduce range of motion until comfortable.

instructions.summary: Barbell hip thrust for maximal glute development and hip extension strength.
setup: Sit against a flat bench, upper back across the pad at mid-shoulder-blade height.
Roll barbell over thighs with a barbell pad, feet flat hip-width apart.
Tuck chin to chest.
execution: Drive through heels, thrusting hips up until torso is parallel to floor.
Squeeze glutes hard at top — pause 1 second.
Lower under control until hips nearly touch floor.
common_errors: Hyperextending lower back at top — rib cage should stay down
Feet too far or too close causing quad or lower-back dominance
instructions.breathing_cue: Exhale at top of thrust, inhale on descent.
safety_notes: Use a barbell pad — bare barbell on hip crease is painful under load.

substitutes.reason: No barbell or bench setup available

contraindications.note: Ensure rib-down position at lockout to avoid lumbar hyperextension.

instructions.summary: Seated dumbbell shoulder press for deltoid hypertrophy.
setup: Set bench to 90 degrees (upright).
Dumbbells at shoulder height, elbows at 90 degrees.
Feet flat on floor.
execution: Press to full lockout overhead.
Stop at 90 degrees on descent — do not lower past shoulder level.
Keep elbows slightly forward of the body throughout.
common_errors: Lowering past 90 degrees — excessive shoulder stress
coaching_cues: Stop at 90 degrees on the way down.

contraindications.note: Reduce depth if pain occurs.

instructions.summary: Machine rear delt fly for posterior deltoid and upper back development — key for shoulder health and posture.
setup: Sit facing the machine pad (reverse position).
Grip handles with overhand grip, arms at shoulder height.
Slight bend in elbows throughout.
execution: Sweep arms out and back in a wide arc.
Lead with elbows, not hands.
Squeeze rear delts and upper back at peak.
Return under control.
common_errors: Pulling with biceps by bending elbows excessively

contraindications.note: Reduce range of motion if pain occurs.

instructions.summary: Prone machine curl isolating the hamstrings with hips pressed flat into the pad to eliminate hip flexor compensation.
setup: Lie face down, knee joint aligned with machine pivot.
Pad rests above heels.
Hips pressed firmly into the pad.
execution: Curl heels toward glutes.
Keep hips pressed hard into pad at all times.
Hold at peak contraction.
Lower under control to full extension.
common_errors: Hips lifting off pad — reduces hamstring isolation

substitutes.reason: No prone leg curl machine available

contraindications.note: Ensure hips stay pressed into pad — no lumbar hyperextension.

instructions.summary: Seated calf raise primarily targeting the soleus, due to the bent-knee position reducing gastrocnemius contribution.
setup: Sit with knees under the pad at 90 degrees.
Balls of feet on the platform edge, heels hanging.
execution: Rise onto toes, squeeze at peak.
Lower slowly — 2-second pause at full stretch.
Do not bounce at the bottom.
common_errors: Bouncing at bottom — removes stretch stimulus

instructions.summary: Kneeling hip flexor stretch targeting iliopsoas and rectus femoris — primary intervention for anterior pelvic tilt (APT) correction.
setup: Kneel facing away from a wall.
Place rear shin and foot up the wall, knee on a mat.
Front foot flat on floor, shin vertical.
execution: Squeeze the glute of the rear (stretching) leg hard.
Drive hip forward while maintaining the glute squeeze.
Hold the stretch for the full duration.
Maintain an upright torso — do not lean forward.
common_errors: Not squeezing glute of the stretching leg — reduces stretch effectiveness
Leaning forward and losing hip position
instructions.breathing_cue: Breathe steadily and relax deeper into the stretch on each exhale.
safety_notes: Use a soft pad under the kneeling knee.

tracking.note_prompt: Log time in seconds per side.

contraindications.note: Use a thick pad under the kneeling knee.
